verdict.rationale: Pinecone documents a specific multitenancy pattern (one namespace per tenant on a serverless index), with docs on backups, RBAC, and security features that support per-tenant isolation. However, the evidence lacks documented per-namespace/tenant limits (max namespaces, quotas, cost-per-tenant economics) and no independent/hands-on validation of multitenancy at scale is present. Missing for 10: documented numeric limits on namespaces/tenants per index, cost-at-scale guidance, and independent verification of multi-tenant isolation in production.
